name: Piercing the Veil
summary: In Deathknell, Venya Marthand tests a novice warlock's resolve. The newly risen Forsaken must gather skulls from nearby mindless skeletons to earn the knowledge to summon and bind an imp.

sections.title: A Novice's First Step
sections.body: In Deathknell, Venya Marthand teaches newly awakened Forsaken warlocks that strength comes from knowledge and mastery of chaotic powers. She sends novices to gather skulls from the Rattlecage Skeletons near Deathknell's abandoned smithy. The trial tests whether they have the focus to command powers beyond this world and subdue nether beings.

sections.title: Subjugating the Nether
sections.body: Venya accepts the skulls as proof that a novice can overcome mindless undead and face the bleak truths of warlock craft. She then teaches the rituals to summon and bind an imp. Though small, the demon brings cunning and fire, making it a dangerous ally.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Piercing the Veil?
faq.answer: Venya Marthand, the Forsaken warlock trainer in Deathknell, gives the trial.

faq.q: What must you collect to complete this quest?
aliases: what do i collect for piercing the veil
faq.answer: You collect three Rattlecage Skulls from Rattlecage Skeletons near Deathknell's ruined smithy.

faq.q: Why does Venya Marthand want skeleton skulls?
faq.answer: Hunting mindless skeletons tests a novice warlock's control, resolve, and basic magical skill before Venya trusts them with more dangerous demonic rituals.

faq.q: What power or minion do you learn to summon?
faq.answer: The lesson prepares a warlock to summon and bind an imp, the first demonic companion they learn to command.

faq.q: Where are the Rattlecage Skeletons located?
faq.answer: Rattlecage Skeletons wander Deathknell's outskirts, especially around the crumbling, abandoned smithy northwest of the main town clearing.

faq.q: Who is eligible to undertake this quest?
aliases: who can take piercing the veil
faq.answer: Forsaken warlocks with introductory training in Deathknell can undertake this trial.

angles.text: As a warlock, you take your first true step into demonology and learn that chaotic magic must bend to iron will.
As a Forsaken, you draw on your detachment from mortality as you study chaotic and dark magic in Deathknell's shadows.
